finding.before: cleanupInternal recursively removed unknown staging and inactive installed entries. Recovery and failed-install cleanup also recursively removed directory contents without admitting a complete owned closure.
finding.correction: Canonical marker/pointer or hash-bound orphan manifest ownership plus bounded direct-file inventory. Candidate paths must be absent. Remove only admitted direct files, manifest last, then the empty directory nonrecursively. Preserve failed-candidate markers and invalid-active pointer authority until dependent content is gone.
finding.commitOrdering: Ownership checks precede authorizeCommit; no added I/O between successful commit authorization and active pointer replacement.

bounds.unknownEntryPolicy: Refuse with model-composition-store-cleanup-ownership and retain unexpected bytes. Unsafe/duplicate adapter names fail typed adapter/path admission.
bounds.cooperatingWriters: Existing exclusive Web Lock remains mandatory; no isolation claim against arbitrary same-origin code.

developmentResults.interpretation: Eleven cleanup refusal cases, corrupt-active recovery and failed candidate cleanup reproduced unsafe behavior; parent aggregation adds one reported failure.
Existing immediate-commit test rejected ownership reads inserted after authorizeCommit. Moved reads before authorization; retained exact assertion.
